capabilities: Detect clipboard content and convert it to clean Markdown when pasting
Repair LaTeX math delimiters and AI-generated math artifacts
Clean text copied from PDFs and extract main article content from HTML
Save, name, dedupe and optionally compress pasted images
Run ordered regex or JavaScript find-and-replace rules on pasted text
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states mobile support has passed simulated checks but is not yet verified on physical Android or iOS devices, and warns that JavaScript rules are not sandboxed.
problem: Obsidian's native paste inserts copied content with broken math delimiters, AI formatting artifacts, tracking URLs, and messy PDF line breaks that need manual cleanup.

Paste Transform, Defuddle, Auto Link Title, Fix Math
The included article reader is a lightweight implementation, not the full Defuddle library

Auto Link Title, Fix Math, Paste as HTML

summary: Smart paste handler that turns copied HTML, AI text, math, PDF text, URLs and images into clean Markdown, with previews and custom regex rules.
